description: The full text of one public page as Markdown, by its path: "/" (home), "/about", "/process", "/faq", "/awards", "/work/<slug>", "/news/<slug>" and so on. Use it after search_site or list_work to read and cite the page itself.

path.description: The page path, starting with "/", e.g. "/about" or "/work/<slug>".

name: get_page
title: Read a page as Markdown
